purpose: Fix pilot for the measured motion collapse: per-sample flow loss weighted by the target segment's latent temporal-difference magnitude (alpha 1, batch-normalized, clipped to [0.25, 4]). Targets the training-signal imbalance measured in the data: rest-dominated windows outnumber action windows (mean joint speed 0.033 m/frame at the 0.7-2 s action peak versus 0.009-0.013 in the rest tails). Matched to the plain start-aligned H8 2k control.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: A two-thousand-step single-seed pilot diagnoses motion onset; it is not a final architecture ranking.
